Elias stood in the wind for a long time, watching the horizon, thinking about the gap between a message sent and a message received, and all the cold water that fills that gap.", "w02": "凌晨四点，城市还没有醒来，却也没有真正睡着。路灯将湿漉漉的柏油路染成橘黄色，偶尔一辆环卫车缓缓驶过，刷子摩擦地面的声音显得格外清晰。便利店的玻璃门透出白光，店员趴在柜台上打盹。楼上某扇窗亮着，不知是失眠者还是赶稿人。远处立交桥上，一辆货车拖着低沉的轰鸣消失在夜色里。空气里有露水的气味，混着隔夜油烟。城市在这个时刻像一台巨大的机器，停了大半，却仍有几个零件在悄悄转动，维持着某种最低限度的运行。", "w03": "• Recursion is when a function solves a big problem by first solving a smaller version of the exact same problem — like finding the smallest doll inside a set of nesting dolls by opening one doll at a time.\n• Every recursive function has a stopping point called the base case — the smallest problem it can answer directly without opening another doll.\n• Each time the function calls itself, the problem gets a little smaller, until it hits the base case and starts handing answers back up the chain."}
